environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed within an EKS-hosted service mesh (Istio 1.19). The Lambda is wrapped via AWS Lambda Web Adapter and runs as a pod in the 'report-engine' namespace. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with a DENY action for any request where the source principal does NOT match 'cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/gateway-proxy'. Additionally, a PeerAuthentication policy enforces STRICT mTLS for the namespace, meaning only pods with valid SPIFFE identities issued by the mesh CA can communicate. The report-generation endpoint is only reachable through the internal mesh sidecar (envoy) which terminates at the pod. External traffic hitting the pod directly is rejected by the iptables rules injected by istio-init. The AuthorizationPolicy spec: apiVersion security.istio.io/v1beta1, kind AuthorizationPolicy, metadata.namespace=report-engine, spec.action=DENY, spec.rules[0].from[0].notSource.principals=['cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/gateway-proxy'], applied to workload selector app=report-engine.

config.network_policy: pod-level iptables via istio-init, no NodePort/LoadBalancer exposure
config.ingress: internal mesh only, no external ingress gateway configured for this service
